a deformation mesh covers the whole approved drawing (no dropped pixels)
CONTACT_END requires a release; TARGET_STATE_CHANGE requires the requested state of the correct object
direction decisions need a consuming operation with the named effect
approved action phrases are the ONE source of plan.phrases
direction authoring is an honest external handoff; the engine never claims authorship
one persistent rig state timeline (no reset between actions/shots)
equal-frame events resolve by numeric priority, independent of input order
hand closure comes from the HAND channel with its approved drawing (never the body pose); grips need contracts
a deformation mesh tiles the drawing by real geometry and is approved by hash-scoped receipt
all approvals include every channel state
feasibility is executed over every required frame; zero evaluation is NOT_EVALUATED
frame-evaluation exceptions are recorded failures, never skipped
preflight is read-only; a stage with obligations but no producing task fails
the film revision hashes code content, not size/mtime
the renderer resolves its plan deterministically; blur frames carry owner attribution; audio is muxed into the final MP4 and re-verified there
semantic consequences (OPEN/GRIP/PLANT/MECHANISM) are measured, never assumed
cross-stage production IR arrows resolve or name the missing boundary
grounded shadows are cast by the limb that carries the planted foot
handoff bundles are portable (project identity + generation, never an absolute path) and self-contained (motion contract, import template)
every direction decision is performed by its own owner (measured), and is visible in that owner's pixels
a proposal compiles only under its own verified approval receipt; instructions name tools that exist
the final film decision is verified over the exact published file
a human can sign: request export → offline signature → verified import, for every reviewable scope
revoked keys and envelopes of another film are refused
a rotation-only camera is a moving interval
the art demand closes over the production plan: acting states, morphs, symbols, sprites, light planes, every world plate, every camera frame
direction approval covers decisions, semantic actions and phrases
attended subjects are not cropped and art is not enlarged beyond its range, on every frame
a grip is measured on painted pixels and by finger layers
an IR arrow is satisfied only by the decision's own subject in its own frames
measured narration cannot be overridden; the director's relation and recognition hold are verified
the rendered frame equals the frame re-applied from its compiled state
stage tasks run in dependency order; unknown dependencies block; the manifest is validated at S03
an effect, deformation or camera decision is proven by its own isolated pixels
the near/far finger topology of every grip is decided (layers or a stated single-layer reason)
evidence builders never write outside their output path
an obligation belongs to its own stage
